recognize_zh: 黑箭頭是多核、核呈分離圓形而非分葉的巨核細胞，紅箭頭是約前骨髓細胞大小的微小巨核細胞；紫箭頭的嗜中性球顆粒少、分葉異常，對照綠箭頭的正常嗜中性球，顯示多系發育不良。
features: Megakaryocyte (black arrow) with multiple widely separated round, non-lobated nuclei in abundant blue cytoplasm
Micromegakaryocyte (red arrow): promyelocyte-sized cell with two small round dense nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm
Dysplastic neutrophil (purple arrow): hypogranular cytoplasm with abnormal nuclear segmentation and clumped chromatin
Normal granulated segmented neutrophil (green arrow) for comparison
Cellular smear with granulocytic and erythroid precursors, central clump of cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular with a mixture of granulocytic and erythroid precursors. Megakaryocytes are dysplastic, including a multinucleated form with widely separated round non-lobated nuclei and a small micromegakaryocyte approximately the size of a promyelocyte. Scattered neutrophils show cytoplasmic hypogranularity and abnormal nuclear segmentation compared with adjacent normal neutrophils. Findings are consistent with multilineage dysplasia in a therapy-related myeloid neoplasm; blast enumeration and cytogenetics are required.

ddx.dx: Reactive megakaryocytic changes (e.g., post-chemotherapy recovery, ITP)
ddx.vs: Reactive megakaryocytes may be increased or young but remain large with lobated nuclei, without micromegakaryocytes or separated round nuclei.
Morphology is identical; separation rests on documented prior cytotoxic therapy or radiation.
Osteoclasts have multiple uniform separate nuclei each with a nucleolus and granular pink cytoplasm, unlike megakaryocytes with dense chromatin and bluish cytoplasm.
B12/folate deficiency shows hypersegmented neutrophils and megaloblastic erythroid nuclei with open chromatin, and resolves with replacement.
